beats.speaker: narration
beats.text: Riley's back, having actually made the call this time.

beats.speaker: client
beats.text: "I told them no. Not because I'm angry anymore — I actually looked at the whole thing honestly, first time in years, and no is just... true."

options.text: What did looking at it honestly actually show you?
You should've said yes out of loyalty.
Why does honesty matter here at all?

beats.speaker: client
beats.text: "That I spent years playing someone else's songs and calling it a compromise. It wasn't a compromise. It was hiding."

beats.speaker: reader
beats.text: You turn over the top card.

options.text: That's the real reckoning — an honest look back before anything new can actually begin.
Reckonings are about punishing yourself for the past.
This card has nothing to do with looking backward.

elaboration: A reckoning — reviewing the past honestly before moving forward. And rebirth requires passing through an ending first, not around it.

beats.speaker: client
beats.text: "So what happens now? I don't even know what my own music sounds like without them in it."

options.text: You find out — your voice was always yours, just waiting for room to actually be used.
You'll never find that out, it's gone.
Your voice isn't relevant to this decision.

elaboration: Letting go of what no longer belongs to you makes room for healing — and your voice is finally ready to be used, on its own terms.

beats.speaker: client
beats.text: "...Yeah. I think I'm ready to actually find out."
